column1: # JSON SCHEMA EXPORT -- the bridge to every structured-output API.
# The review's finding I / SUPPORT.md act 2. Every major LLM provider's
# structured-output API constrains generation to JSON Schema and to
# nothing else, so without an export a model cannot ride that path and
# then be `vet`ted as the semantic gate -- and an MCP tool's
# `inputSchema`, which the protocol REQUIRES to be JSON Schema, cannot
# be derived from an Aontu tool model at all.
# EVERY EXPECTATION HERE WAS OBTAINED BY RUNNING BOTH ENGINES AND
# DIFFING. The expect object is the schema AND the loss report, because
# a schema that silently DROPPED a construct would look identical to one
# that carried it -- and a dropped constraint makes the schema admit
# MORE than the model does, which is the failure this language exists to
# refuse. The CLI's envelope (version, verb) is not compared.
# WHAT CROSSES EXACTLY: kinds to types, concrete scalars to `const`, a
# disjunction of scalars to `enum` (and its preference to `default`),
# bounds to minimum/maximum with the OPEN endpoints as the exclusive
# keywords, `re` to `pattern` (Aontu's portable subset is a subset of
# ECMA-262, which is what JSON Schema reads), `neq` to `not: {enum}`,
# uniqueItems, optional keys to an absence from `required`, and -- the
# one Aontu and JSON Schema say identically -- `close()` to
# `additionalProperties: <template>`, which is what it means; a written
# list is a TUPLE, so prefixItems plus items:false.
# WHAT DOES NOT, AND IS REPORTED: an evaluate-only `must()` (opaque by
# construction), the exact `0d` leaves (JSON has one number type and it
# is binary64), `unique(k)` (JSON Schema has no uniqueness-by-property
# keyword), a hidden entry (not generated, so not part of the value a
# consumer produces), a spread on a closed map, and any residue -- an
# unresolved reference is not a property constraint, and guessing one

column4: {"lossy":[{"construct":"biginteger","path":"$.a","reason":"JSON has one number type and it is binary64, so the EXACTNESS this leaf exists for cannot be carried; the schema says \\"integer\\" and a consumer may round"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"bigdecimal","path":"$.a","reason":"JSON has one number type and it is binary64, so the EXACTNESS this leaf exists for cannot be carried; the schema says \\"number\\" and a consumer may round"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"type":"number"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"exact literal","path":"$.a","reason":"JSON has one number type and it is binary64, so this exact value is emitted as the nearest JSON number"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"const":5,"type":"integer"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"hide","path":"$.a.x","reason":"a hidden entry is not generated, so it is omitted from the schema; a consumer is neither asked for it nor allowed to know about it"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"properties":{"y":{"const":2,"type":"integer"}},"required":["y"],"type":"object"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"must","path":"$.a","reason":"an evaluate-only check is opaque by construction -- it carries the author's own message and the algebra never reasons about it -- so it is DROPPED and the schema admits values `vet` refuses"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"exact literal","path":"$","reason":"JSON has one number type and it is binary64, so this exact value is emitted as the nearest JSON number"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","const":1.5,"type":"number"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"exact literal","path":"$.a","reason":"JSON has one number type and it is binary64, so this exact value is emitted as the nearest JSON number"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"const":1.5,"type":"number"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"length","path":"$.a","reason":"a count with no domain is exported as minItems/maxItems; JSON Schema has no keyword that counts a string OR a container"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"minItems":2}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"unique(k)","path":"$.a","reason":"JSON Schema has no uniqueness-by-property keyword; uniqueItems compares whole items, so this constraint is DROPPED and the schema admits records sharing a `k`"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"hide","path":"$.a.x","reason":"a hidden entry is not generated, so it is omitted from the schema; a consumer is neither asked for it nor allowed to know about it"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"properties":{},"type":"object"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"&:","path":"$.a","reason":"a spread on a CLOSED map constrains keys that cannot exist, so additionalProperties:false stands alone and the template is dropped"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"x":{"const":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["x"],"type":"object"}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}

{"lossy":[{"construct":"nil","path":"$.a","reason":"this is not a value yet, so there is nothing to constrain a consumer to; the schema admits anything here"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}
